senses.gloss: f. (b. h.; = מסוערה, v. סָעַר II) storm-beaten, restless.
units: Pesik. R. s. 32; Yalk. Is. 339 ס׳ מערערתאוכ׳soʿărah וכ׳ (Is. LIV, 11) means stirred up, for the nations have stirred her (Israel) up (with ref. to Ps. CXXXVII, 7). [Pesik. R. l. c. ס׳ מן המצות, read, with Yalk. l. c., עֲנִיָּיה.]
